_comment: Corpus acquisition seeds. Drug names and condition names are NOT listed here: they are read from the decision-bindings model (models/<usecase>/decision-bindings.xmi) so that the corpus covers exactly the entities the explanations will need. This file only holds search terms that have no model counterpart.

pubmed._comment: esearch: (query) [AND (filter)] AND humans[MeSH Terms] AND english[Language] AND min_year:3000[dp] AND hasabstract, sorted by relevance, max_per_query ids per query (a query object may override it and name the collection its results belong to, default corpus/pubmed), union over queries. PubMed relevance ranking is not stable over time: a query that has been run is pinned (its PMIDs are recorded in the manifest and re-fetched exactly); a query new to this file is run once and pinned in turn (--force re-runs every query).
queries: diabetes readmission discharge skilled nursing facility

queries.topic: inpatient diabetes management: practice guidelines, consensus statements, standards of care
queries.query: (diabet*[ti] OR hyperglyc*[ti] OR hypoglyc*[ti] OR glycemic[ti] OR glycaemic[ti] OR insulin[ti]) AND (hospital*[ti] OR inpatient*[ti] OR in-patient*[ti] OR noncritical*[ti] OR non-critical*[ti] OR perioperative[ti] OR peri-operative[ti] OR surgery[ti] OR "critically ill"[ti])
queries.filter: guideline[pt] OR practice guideline[pt] OR consensus development conference[pt] OR consensus[ti] OR guideline*[ti] OR recommendation*[ti] OR "position statement"[ti] OR "standards of care"[ti] OR "standards of medical care"[ti]

queries.topic: hospital discharge and transitions of care for patients with diabetes: recommendations
queries.query: (diabet*[ti] OR hyperglyc*[ti] OR insulin[ti] OR glycemic[ti] OR glycaemic[ti]) AND (discharge*[ti] OR "transition of care"[ti] OR "transitions of care"[ti] OR "hospital to home"[ti] OR post-discharge[ti]) AND (hospital*[tiab] OR inpatient*[tiab])
queries.filter: guideline[pt] OR practice guideline[pt] OR consensus development conference[pt] OR review[pt] OR consensus[ti] OR guideline*[ti] OR recommendation*[ti] OR "position statement"[ti] OR practical[ti] OR "best practice"[ti]
